description: A reverb built on Juhana Sadeharju's GigaVerb, working in stereo

notes: the presets listed in the menu are read from a file named ambuance.presets inside the plugin's res folder, and can be edited there
menu: Subtract Original Signal From WET — takes the original signal out of the wet path, so the reverb output carries only the reverb
PRESETS — lists nine named reverb settings, each of which sets the room size, the reverb time, the damping, the input bandwidth, the tail level, the early reflections level and the mix
